title: Summer Macrame Drop
body: Hand-tied and sun-kissed ☀️ Our summer collection is here — pastel cords, custom charms, and same-day pickup at pop-ups. Link in bio to shop or customize yours.

title: Boho Tassel Keychain
body: Each knot tells a story. This boho tassel keychain is hand-crafted using premium waxed cord with your choice of accent bead — turquoise, amethyst, or pearl. Measures 5" and ships within 2 business days.

title: Pop-Up at Riverside Park
body: We'll be at Riverside Park Pavilion on June 21 — come find us! Bring a friend and get a second custom keychain at 20% off. Same-day customization available.
